perspective:
**From Jose Castillo’s perspective:**

- He noticed Patricia seemed more withdrawn and less vibrant than usual at work, so he asked if she was okay.
- Patricia told him it was “nothing really,” just “some personal stuff,” and thanked him for asking.
- He offered to listen if she ever wanted to talk, and she said she appreciated that.
- He later overheard Patricia on the phone sounding worried about bills and financial commitments.
- He brought up financial planning strategies he had been reading about and offered to discuss budgeting tips together.
- Patricia said she had been overwhelmed with bills lately and would take him up on the offer soon.
- He worried afterward that he might have overstepped, so he told Patricia he only wanted to help, not pry.
- Patricia assured him she didn’t think he was prying and was grateful for the offer.
- He told her he respected her privacy and wanted to support her as a friend; Patricia said it meant a lot to have someone to turn to.
- Later, he checked in casually. Patricia said she was doing fine and planned a quiet weekend at home.
- He continued offering support, saying she could reach out if she needed anything or just wanted to chat.
- Patricia thanked him for checking in and said she appreciated his support.

Jose knows Patricia has been dealing with some personal stress and financial worries, but she has not shared specific details with him.
